current_pass_goal: Instrument the already pinned Boxcars oracle temporarily and collect first-frame plus first-actor-envelope-header differential evidence across all 47 currently supported replays without modifying MIMIR production code.
current_pass_stop_boundary: Stop after time, delta, actor_present, actor_id, alive, and new. Do not consume name_id, object spawn payload, spawn trajectory payload, property payload, attribute payload, or additional frame envelopes.
bounded_integer_rule: Not fixed-width. Decode low bits according to bound and preserve the value-dependent extra discriminator-bit behavior used by Rocket League/Boxcars.
closed_now: counterfactual rollout execution from native replay state
permanent_process_constraints: evidence and production implementation are separate passes
no capability claim without production code plus real tests plus audit

temporary GitHub workflows/scripts do not enter the clean production commit

full validation runs against the exact clean SHA
